home.badge: Digital reports only · No OCR · No fabrication
home.title: Understand your medical report, line by line.
home.subtitle: Upload a text-based PDF report — CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid Profile, Thyroid, and more. We extract every value directly from your document, verify test names against a clinical reference, and explain each one in plain language, a student's depth, or a doctor's precision.
home.pillar1Body: Every fact comes from your report. If something isn't found, we say so — never invented.
home.pillar2Body: Switch between Patient, Student, and Doctor explanations for the same result.
home.pillar3Body: Read every explanation in the language that's easiest for you.
home.noReports: No reports uploaded yet. Upload your first digital PDF report to get started.

upload.title: Upload a report
upload.subtitle: Digital, text-based PDF reports only — CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid Profile, Thyroid, Urine, Diabetes, MRI, CT, ECG, X-Ray, Prescriptions, or Discharge Summaries. Scanned or handwritten reports aren't supported yet.
upload.dropHint: Drag & drop your PDF here, or
upload.processingHint: Extracting text, verifying test names, building your report index
upload.whatHappensBody: We extract text directly from the PDF, parse patient info and lab values with rule-based parsing, verify test names against a local clinical reference, and build a private search index so the AI chat can answer questions using only your report's content.

settings.title: Settings
settings.explanationModeBody: Applies across the report overview, test cards, and chat.
settings.explanationLanguageBody: Controls the language of AI-generated content: summaries, explanations, chat answers, and flashcards. Telugu is written naturally by the AI, not machine-translated.
settings.interfaceLanguageBody: Controls the app's menus, buttons, and labels. Translated instantly, without calling the AI.
settings.privacyBody: Reports are processed and stored locally by this application's backend. No data is sent to third parties except the configured AI provider, used only to generate explanations from your extracted report text.
settings.privacyDisclaimer: This app provides educational information only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
